about: FFXIV Japanese glossary used by dudu的書 when the text being translated is Japanese. Each entry renders the term in every supported target language (en, zh-TW, id); the plugin uses the one matching the user's target. Compiled from ffxiv_jp_en_dataset.json (src=dataset) plus curated FFXIV community usage (src=curated). mode=phrase rows are whole-message lines; all other rows are terms injected inside sentences. next=katakana / next=end restrict what may follow a term.
